tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags ma ri khrod lo ma gyon ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/

༄༅// gar skad du/ ārya parna sha ba ri nā ma dha ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma ri khrod lo ma gyon pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen thob la phyag 'tshal lo// mi'u thung khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das ma mi'u thung sha za mo/ ri khrod lo ma gyon pa sha za mo khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhags pa dang dgra sta thogs ma 'jigs pa gang dag ci byung ba de dag thams cad dang*/ yams kyi nad gang dag ci byung yang rung ba dang*/ 'chi byed gang dag ci byung yang rung ba dang*/ 'chi byed chen po gang dag ci byung yang rung ba dang*/ gnod pa gang dag ci byung yang rung ba dang*/ 'khrug pa gang dag ci byung yang rung ba dang*/ khong du gnod pa gang dag ci byung yang rung ba dang*/ gang dag ci byung ba de dag thams cad ni byis pa kho na la byung gi /mkhas pa dag la ni ma yin no/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des song zhig song zhig /mkhas pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag gis che ge mo zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig /yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su bzung ba dang*/ yongs su bskyang ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa spang ba dang*/ mtshon cha spang ba dang*/ dug gzhil ba dang*/ dug bsad pa dang*/ mtshams bcad pa dang*/ sa bcing bar gyis shig /tadya thā/ oṃ a mṛ te/ ā shā stang gi /mā mā rā/ mā mā rā// sha mā pā ra/ sha ma u pa sha mā/ tu nu pī/ nu tu tu tu/ tu mu le swā hā/ na ma sha ba ra na nan/ oṃ pi sha tsi parna sha ba ri pi sha tsi swā hā/ oṃ parna sha ba ri hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ aṅgu re parna sha ba ri ye swā hā/
oṃ pi sha tsi parna sha ba ri swā hā/ sarba ma ri bā sha ma ni/ sarba duṣṭan ni bhan dha mu ga na hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ 'phags ma ri khrod lo ma gyon pa'i gzungs rdzogs so/// /
